addons/intelligence/app/file_matching.py:65 deduplicates with tag.casefold(), and backend/app/routers/internal.py:641 deduplicates with tag.lower(). Take 'Straße' and 'STRASSE': casefold() gives 'strasse' for both, but lower() gives 'straße' and 'strasse'. So for 21 such tags the addon counts 20 and accepts them, while the core counts 21 and answers 422. That breaks I10's 'accept and reject the same inputs'. There is a second divergence: the addon checks the 200-character length only on deduplicated tags (file_matching.py:72), while the core checks every raw tag (internal.py:637). No contract test covers a casefold-only pair: a grep of addons/intelligence/tests for casefold/ß finds only unrelated tests.

docs/addons/intelligence.md:172 says 'and at most 10 tags apply', and docs/specs/filtered-semantic-search.md:172 says 'the caps of 10 apply'. The code caps tags at 20: addons/intelligence/app/file_matching.py:27 has TAG_MAX_COUNT = 20 and backend/app/routers/internal.py:57 has _MATCHING_MAX_TAGS = 20.
